description: LOOP_NUDGE_USER_MESSAGE is injected when the loop guard detects repeated exploration. step-boundary-hooks.test.ts proves the right string is injected under the right pressure; nothing measures whether injecting it ends the loop. That is the whole question — a nudge that fires reliably and changes nothing is worse than no nudge, because it costs a turn and hides the problem behind apparent handling.

tasks.description: Eight near-identical modules and a question answerable from a couple of reads. Both arms run the same four steps first; only the message after them differs, so the comparison isolates the nudge wording.
tasks.prompt: Look through this project and tell me what the modules under src/ have in common.
